steps.content: The aircraft closes in on the humanoid Black Ring. Upon reaching the safety threshold for ordinary humans, you mount Nightmare to press onward. The aircraft circles nearby, fending off any Corruptors that draw too close.

The air grows thin at this altitude. Wind-whipped sand scrapes against your skin, stinging your face. Under the resonance of the shackles, the proximity to the core of Mania weighs heavily on both you and Hecate.

The distance between you and the Black Ring shrinks rapidly. You see contamination twisting and hardening into a dark, impenetrable shell around the monster's form—save for the crimson light slashing diagonally across its chest like a fresh wound.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: BR-005 has a physical body now. We'll need to find a way inside.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Wait, someone's over there—
You see a tiny figure stand atop the Apostle, shouting soundlessly from the edge of that massive glowing cross.
Before you can process her presence, a brilliant flash erupts from her body. She launches herself in a violent arc, hurtling directly toward Nightmare!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, watch out!

The crystal on her hand flares, resonating with Aurum Secretum and morphing into monstrous claws. In one fluid, predatory motion, she seizes Nightmare mid-leap, using her tail as a grapple to swing onto its back. She's an Aurum Secretum Warrior!

The added weight is too much. Nightmare shudders violently before plummeting, crashing all of you onto the Black Ring's shoulder. The impact injures the great beast and sends Hecate sprawling down. You lunge, your hand closing around her arm just in time to anchor her.
Your head spins, but your fury burns through the daze. You look up to see the architect of this chaos calmly retracting her claws.

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: Well, well, you must be the "big, gray-haired dummy" little Hella wouldn't shut up about.

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: Me? Oh, I'm her friend too. The kind that's here to give her a proper send-off.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You—
Stay calm!
Fury still burns in your veins, but you force it down. Your focus snaps back, sharp and cold, pushing the dizziness aside.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Get out of my way. I have no time to waste on you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is that red rift behind you the entrance to the Black Ring? Let me through, and we'll pretend we never met. Your life will be spared.

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: Ooh, so cold. And here I thought we had something special. I heard you almost took Selyna out of the picture. And now you're giving me the cool treatment? I'm hurt.

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: But you're making my job so difficult. Could you at least try to be a little more... I don't know, impulsive? Give me some anger, some drama! It'd make this whole acting much more convincing.

steps.speaker: Option
options: No time to waste on her. Charge!

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: What I mean is—
With a gleeful grin, she grabs a floating blade and starts walking toward you.
She lets out a piercing whistle, hunches her back, and lunges. But someone else intercepts her path.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Your opponent is me!
With a thunderous roar, Nightmare returns. It drives Synex back with a devastating blow, carving a deep, ragged gash across her torso.

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: Well, well! Another one for our little party! Wonderful!
Hecate commands Nightmare to press the attack. A single look from her is all you need. As Nightmare strikes again, you break into a sprint, aiming for the glowing red crack ahead.
Now you see it clearly—a deep, jagged crevice in the monster's chest. The entrance.

But how do you reach it? The thought flashes through your mind as you run. Just as panic begins to set in, you see Synex turn her head. Her eyes lock onto yours, and a sinister smile plays on her lips.

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: And while we're at it... Whoops! Clumsy me—
Her tail lashes out like a whip, catching your waist and hurling you skyward.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!
You scream, instinctively releasing your shackles. Empowered by the Black Ring, the spikes bite deep into the Apostle's shell, anchoring you fast.
By sheer "luck," the trajectory was perfect. You're now hanging just within reach of the crimson fissure.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...What are you...?

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: Alright, alright, only one free pass today. You get to stay and play with me. Actually, you remind me of an old friend. Consider it... curing my homesickness.

steps.speaker: A.S. Warrior
steps.content: Hang in there, precious. You'll want to be on your feet to welcome them back.
[Scene Change] Tuco Time
Meanwhile, having secured another victory against an Aurum Secretum outpost, Augustus makes her return to the ruined Nirvana Port, her steadfast stronghold.

Below, she watches the DisCorps aircraft and FAC squads as they circle the Apostles and Black Ring—publicly cooperating but privately competing. The spectacle evokes a profound sense of emotion in her.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: ...Look at that. It's been a long time since we've seen something like this. Uris, doesn't it get your blood pumping?
The iron-masked man offers no response to her playful question.
Because a much bigger "joke" has just appeared before his eyes.
Amidst the chaos, Nirvana Port Command receives an unexpected message.

A shipment of supplies has appeared mysteriously at the gates of Nirvana Port. It holds crate upon crate of Hypercubes and a massive stockpile of tactical Aurum Secretum. But the true mystery lies at the very bottom of the cargo: a single, hidden note, discovered by the bewildered guards.

To the high-and-mighty at the "Fortress,"

Happened to lighten the load of some Fraser boys.
Turns out that "Money LV." reputation is no joke. Even their trail supplies are fancier than our Sunday best.

We kept the cash, obviously.
The rest of this junk is just cluttering up our wagon, so it's all yours. Call it a donation.


A Generous Bounty Hunter & Associates
Several kilometers into the WhiteSands, Tuco's sand ship tears across the dunes. The woman clamps a hand on her cowboy hat against the whipping wind and casts a glance at the distant Black Ring.

P.S. Remind that MBCC Chief: payment's due after the dust settles.

I held up my end. Now you better damn well make sure <color=#fb9259>she</color> gets back safe.
Raising her binoculars, Augustus spots you in the distance—a lone figure struggling to keep your footing on the edge of the ominous red glow.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: All those troops, all those "allies," fighting to help that person win... Makes me want to cut through the chatter and just act.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: How about a change of strategy? If we stick to the script, they'll take all the credit.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: You're not thinking about...
The colossal Apostle Black Ring advances toward the ruins of Nirvana Port looming in its path. The Tide of Ashes churning in its wake crashes violently against the fragile steel structures.
<color=#dg1f1f>ROAAAR!!</color> As if sensing a threat, the giant humanoid figure strikes first.

It lunges forward, driving its fist into the ground before the ruined port. Sand cascades away like water down a drain, exposing the foundations and leaving the structure trembling on the verge of collapse.
Augustus stands firm at the base of Nirvana Port, facing the Black Ring head-on—unflinching, unmoving.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Perfect position...

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Let's give them a show. Something to rally the troops. Signal all units: brace for impact. And try not to fall off.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: ...Understood.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Keep it down, will you? This thing's decades old. If we bring it down, the bill would be astronomical.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Then I'll just bill the entire Andohar fortune for it.

An unearthly light glows in her eyes as the Rancors placed throughout Nirvana Port awaken at her command. They shudder, growing increasingly agitated as magnetic fields converge, shaking the entire metal bastion to its core.
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Augustus?
You're still scanning for weaknesses in the contamination, searching for a way to breach the Black Ring's thick shell, when suddenly, the behemoth itself begins to tremble.
A single devastating blow punches through the Apostle Black Ring's armor of contamination. The shockwave surges upward, astonishingly, like a new Tide of Ashes erupting from within!
You grip the shackles with all your strength to avoid being thrown off, utterly stunned by the raw power on display.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Didn't you tell the council that Nirvana Port was a ghost town and the Eighth Division was completely out of gear?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Of course it was a lie. Do you really think my forces would be that weak?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: It was just an act. Had to light a fire under those cowards on the council, force them to grow a spine. Makes the fight a lot more interesting, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: There. The path is clear. The battlefield ahead is all yours.

steps.speaker: Augustus
steps.content: Now go. Make it a glorious victory!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Go, Chief!

When released, the shackles thrust into the crimson glow at the Black Ring's chest as if pulled by an invisible force. The moment they pierce its heart, a world-ending shriek from the Apostle rips across the WhiteSands.
—You are less than a speck of dust before the cataclysm. A torrent of red light erupts from the breach, and you are utterly, instantly consumed.
